shared_elements: shallow low-relief carving on a large upright pillar/slab
anthropomorphic pillar form with broad flat head and narrower shaft
bent limb / arm-like relief with angular elbow
long incised curving or straight lines running across the shaft (belt- or arm-like bands)
vertical banded strip along the edge of the shaft
justification: Both surfaces are upright, broad-headed pillar-like slabs bearing very low, flat relief with angular bent limb motifs and long incised lines/bands descending the shaft, giving the impression of an abstracted body treated in the same schematic, outline-with-flat-plane convention. The clearest difference in content is that A carries a distinct quadruped shown in profile with clawed feet and a raised tail crossing the pillar face, whereas B shows no recognisable animal, only limbs, bands and indeterminate raised forms.
